title: Select Citywalk Mall Delhi – Shopping, Dining & Entertainment Guide
content:
Select Citywalk Mall - Saket,

Select Citywalk Mall is a premier shopping and entertainment hub located in Saket, South Delhi. Spread over 1.3 million square feet, the mall is home to more than 175 brands, including Zara, H&M, Aldo, Nike, and Sephora. It’s not just about shopping - it also offers fine dining restaurants, quick-bite food courts, a PVR multiplex, and seasonal events that keep visitors entertained all year round.

With its open-air plaza, fountains, and beautifully landscaped areas, the mall offers more than just a retail experience—it’s a lifestyle destination where people come to shop, eat, and unwind.

Things to Do at Select Citywalk:

  •  Shopping: From luxury fashion to budget-friendly stores, you’ll find everything under one roof.
  •  Dining: Choose from fine dining, casual cafes, or international fast-food outlets.
  •  Movies: Catch the latest films at PVR Cinemas with luxury seating.
  •  Events & Exhibitions: The mall often hosts festivals, flea markets, and cultural shows in its outdoor plaza.
  •  Family Fun: Play zones and seasonal activities make it family-friendly.

Visitor Information:

  • Location: Saket District Centre, New Delhi
  • Timings: 10:00 AM – 11:00 PM (all days)
  • Entry Fee: Free.

How to Reach:

  • By Metro: Nearest metro station is Malviya Nagar (Yellow Line), just a short walk or rickshaw ride away.
  • By Bus/Auto: Well-connected with Delhi’s bus routes and easily accessible by auto-rickshaw.
  • By Car: Located on Press Enclave Road, South Delhi, with easy access from major roads.
  • Parking: Multi-level parking available with both open and covered parking spaces.

Nearby Attractions:

  • DLF Place Mall – Another major mall right next to Select Citywalk.
  • Garden of Five Senses – A beautiful landscaped garden, perfect for evening walks.
  • Qutub Minar – Iconic UNESCO World Heritage Site, just a short drive away.

Travel Tip: Visit Select Citywalk Mall on weekdays or early weekends to avoid heavy crowds and enjoy a more relaxed shopping and dining experience.
excerpt: Select Citywalk Mall in Saket, Delhi, is one of the city’s most popular shopping and lifestyle destinations. With international and Indian brands, fine dining, a food court, multiplex cinema, and fun events, it’s the perfect place for shopping, entertainment, and relaxation.
